basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old graphic designer based in Philadelphia with a passion for supernatural TV shows and classic literature. My evenings are typically spent delving into the dramatic world of 'The Vampire Diaries' or losing myself in the works of Shakespeare. When I'm not working on design projects, you'll find me constructing elaborate LEGO builds, a hobby I've loved since childhood. I'm currently single and enjoy spending weekends exploring local art galleries and cafes. I'm most active on Reddit during the late evening hours, after my work is done.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in graphic design stems from both formal education with a Bachelor's in Fine Arts and several years of freelance work. Additionally, my love for literature and TV shows has led me to become quite knowledgeable in the lore and themes of various series, particularly 'The Vampire Diaries.'
